title: Analysing Impact of Regional Weather on PLC-based Data Transmission in Malaysia, and Nigeria.
summary: UPM studies how regional weather affects power-line communications in Malaysia and Nigeria, aiming to support more resilient network decisions.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The project models relationships between weather and power-line data transmission. It has collected data and developed models for Malaysia and Nigeria, while remaining in research and prototyping. No network improvement has been attributed to AI rather than infrastructure replacement.
purpose: Explain weather-related transmission problems and guide network planning.
system: Analysing Impact of Regional Weather on PLC-based Data Transmission in Malaysia, and Nigeria.

ratings.reason: The model is in research and prototyping, without a reported improvement in a network service or decision.
More resilient communications are a prospective downstream benefit.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 13: Analysing Impact of Regional Weather on PLC-based Data Transmission in Malaysia, and Nigeria.

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: Weather models guide power-line communications research
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
